datePolicy: All retained source access dates come from original 2026-11-05 ledger. Eiffel published 2027 tariff and school calendar distinguished from current hotel starting rates, other tariffs, standing schedules and author estimates. No fresh external research.
uncertainties: Hotel starting rates are not July 2027 availability or dated family totals. Jean Bart room cooling/lift/stroller access and Du Levant tax/breakfast/lift inclusions remain unverified; budget requires actual all-in family lodging at or below EUR 1,100.

No official July 2027 Champ de Mars/Concorde staging/closure dates or complete engineering-work calendar established. Paris Plages dates, Tuileries fair/cauldron access and footprints remain unconfirmed. Absence of a retrieved announcement is not an open-access guarantee.

Museum July ticket release and mandatory reservations, general stroller policy, Notre-Dame inconsistent booking-window wording and worship access need reconfirmation. Former Galerie des Enfants is permanently closed.

Exact curb-side accessibility, return-stop geometry and live bus diversions were not verified. RATP indexed register supports Luxembourg/line 14 lifts, not every interchange; exact Luxembourg entrance and real-time lift state need checking.
Other-than-Eiffel future fares/taxi/tourist tax, LudoJardin exact price, sailboat operation/rate, child-seat charges and all journey/meal/hotel-uplift estimates remain conditional.
Airport and flight times unknown; transfer plan assumes CDG/Orly and must change for Beauvais or other arrivals. Flights excluded; reserve may be consumed by lodging or price increases.
editingContract: Readable corresponding English and Simplified Chinese lines and table cells retain identical complete numeric, currency, date and URL literals. Local drafts only; no stars or review markup.
audience: English for families planning Paris with young children; Simplified Chinese for Chinese-speaking families using the same itinerary, transport and room-budget decisions.
